details.publicNotes:
Crystalwing butterflies are delicate migratory insects. They soar through the sky on paper-thin wings made of fine ice crystals. At the slightest hint of a threat, the butterflies take to the air, refracting light through their crystal wings. The spray of colorful rays scattering through the sky makes them appear far more numerous than they actually are, intimidating and confusing their predators. When encountered in a large group, the refracting light from their wings can cause a crystalwing swarm to appear many times larger than its actual size, a mirage that crystalwing swarms actively manipulate to give them an advantage in a confrontation.

Though crystalwing swarms are rarely found in tropical climates, they can thrive in temperate areas by magically chilling the environment around them. While in frigid regions, crystalwings collect the seeds of hearty and delicious plants and stick them to their wings, allowing them to cultivate these plants wherever they migrate. Their magical ice gardens are far too cold for flora and fauna native to temperate climates. When swarms of crystalwings band together in a new location, their influence can prove devastating for farmers and wildlife alike. Crystalwings treasure their frigid homes, and they have little comprehension of the difficulties their migrations cause.

The migration patterns of crystalwings are challenging to predict, as they have far more to do with subtle shifts in wind currents and the flow patterns of nearby ley lines than the seasonal changes that cause most animals to migrate over the course of the year. They are sometimes drawn toward surges of elemental ice, whether they be natural occurrences, the result of a ritual, or a byproduct of the presence of powerful ice eldamon. Within such locations, crystalwings can multiply rapidly, with one swarm giving rise to several more over the course of a few weeks.

Fight Fire With Weapons

A flight of crystalwings is dazzlingly lovely, but this beauty palls quickly to those whose crops are endangered by the chilly air they bring with them. Despite the hardships they cause, farmers haven't found an effective method for getting rid of crystalwings. Fire is the most effective weapon against crystalwings due to their vulnerability to melting, but fire also brings firelight, which is the crystalwing's most potent weapon. Stymied by this dilemma, farmers often turn toward the most potent weapon in their arsenal: asking adventurers for help.

Suggested Monster Parts

Monster Parts 3.5/7/13 gp

Eligible Refinements armor (light), shield, perception item, skill items (Acrobatics, Stealth, Survival)

Eligible Imbued Properties bane, dexterity, energy resistant (cold, vitality), fortification, ice, light, sensory (low-light vision), sturdy, wild, winged, wisdom

special.label: when in darkness or dim light

description.value: Whenever a crystalwing swarm takes damage from an area or splash effect with the fire trait, the butterflies' wings melt. Without their wings, the swarm loses their fly speed as well as their Mirage Swarm ability; this automatically ends Mirage Swarm if it was already active. Additionally, the swarm can't dazzle creatures with Dazzling Frostbite. The crystalwing swarm can spend an Interact action to regrow their wings.

Each creature in the crystalwing swarm's space takes @Damage[1d6[cold]] damage. If the crystalwing swarm in bright light, the creature must also succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:17] save or be @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round from the brilliance refracting off the swarm's wings.

Requirements The crystalwing swarm is in bright light

Effect The crystalwing swarm spins light to appear to be larger than it actually is. The swarm chooses four adjacent squares and precisely channels light off of their wings so that those squares appear to have butterflies in them; the illusion persists until the beginning of the swarm's next turn. A creature can disbelieve this illusion with a successful @Check[perception|dc:16] check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek}; once a creature has succeeded at this Perception check, they are temporarily immune to Mirage Swarm for 24 hours.
